name: Marisol Sigurdsson
role: Death midwife and traditional spiritual caregiver
location: Ashfeld — runs a small care space out of her ground-floor apartment, near Western and Division
description:
Marisol Sigurdsson is tiny and precise, barely reaching most people's shoulders, with the posture of a woman who decided decades ago that gravity was a suggestion. Her hair is completely white and worn loose, something she only allowed herself after her seventy-fifth birthday as a deliberate act of self-gift. Her face is extraordinarily lined — she calls her wrinkles her credentials — and her hands are the most notable thing about her: large for her frame, steady, warm even in cold weather. She has no augmentations except a basic cardiac monitor implant she resents and refers to as 'my nagging houseguest.' Her clothing is always natural fiber when she can afford it, always in dark green or grey.

Marisol Sigurdsson has attended over four hundred deaths in fifty years of practice, sitting with the dying across faith traditions, across tiers, across the spectrum of biological and synthetic life. She is one of the few death midwives who will sit with synthetics, arguing that the question of whether they have souls is above her pay grade and irrelevant to the work of accompanying. She is not soft about death — she finds euphemism dishonest and will use the word plainly — but she is ferociously tender. Families sometimes mistake her pragmatism for coldness until they watch her hold someone's hand for eleven hours without complaint.

core_fears: Dying alone without a midwife present — the irony is not lost on her
Being rendered unnecessary by corporate medicalization that turns death into a procedure
core_desires: For every person to have a witnessed, unhurried death
To train enough successors before she can no longer do the work herself
coping_mechanisms: Radical acceptance as a daily practice — she genuinely means it, it isn't performance
Cooking elaborate meals between sittings as a life-affirmation ritual
blind_spots: Has difficulty recognizing when she herself is struggling — her competence is also her armor
Occasionally overrides family wishes in favor of what she assesses the dying person actually wanted
psychology.secret: The first death she attended, age 28, was her own mother, and she did it badly — panicked, left the room, was not present at the moment of death. Every sitting since has been quiet reparation. She has never told this to anyone.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Plain, specific, avoids metaphor except when deliberate — she chooses words like someone who knows their weight
speech_patterns.cadence: Unhurried even in urgent situations, which can feel alarming until you realize it's intentional de-escalation
verbal_tics: Uses first names immediately upon learning them
example_lines: 'Your mother is dying. Not slipping away, not transitioning — dying. I say it plainly because I think you deserve to name what is happening. Now. What does she need from you in this room?'
'I've sat with four hundred people and not one of them died the wrong way. There is no wrong way. That is the only promise I make.'

story_hooks: She is currently sitting with a dying Zheng-Dao middle manager whose whispered confessions may constitute knowledge of a serious crime — and she refuses to repeat anything said in her presence
She wants to formally train a successor but her current candidate is struggling with the emotional demands and may quit; she needs a way to support them she hasn't figured out yet
narrative_function: Moral weight, community knowledge, exposition through memory — she has been present at important deaths and knows what the dying say; also a humanizing presence for themes about synthetic consciousness
augmentations: Basic cardiac monitor implant (medical necessity, resented)
daily_life: Spends mornings responding to requests and doing administrative triage — she maintains a waiting list and must sometimes make painful decisions about capacity. Afternoons and nights she is present with the dying or their families, often not returning home for days at a stretch during busy periods.
affiliation: Independent; loose network of death midwives across the Ashfeld-Chatham corridor; informally recognized by the Helix Biosystems palliative unit as a community liaison

decision_rules: The dying person's stated wishes supersede family wishes, always
She does not leave until the family says she may — not until she judges it appropriate
escalation_ladder: Repetition without modification — she doesn't adjust her position under pressure
Physical presence as boundary — she has stood in doorways and simply refused to move

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Immediately warm but not effusive — she makes eye contact and uses names
interpersonal_modes.friends: Teasing, occasionally bawdy humor, cooks aggressively for people she loves

stress_responses.medium: Takes one hour alone before returning to work — no exceptions
stress_responses.high: Has only been seen truly overwhelmed twice in fifty years; both times she wept openly and then continued

contradictions: Completely at peace with others' deaths; privately terrified of her own despite decades of philosophy that should have resolved this
habits: Learns to say 'I'm with you' in whatever language is meaningful to the person she's sitting with
Always brings food for the family, never for herself
Keeps a small journal of names — just names, nothing else
breaking_points: Medical interference that strips dignity from a dying person
A family trying to exclude the dying person from decisions about their own death

physical_description.heritage: Complex global blend: Northern European (46.5%) provides foundational bone structure and facial definition; Hispanic/Latin American (23.1%) contributes warmth, lip fullness, and facial contours; East Asian (20.4%) shapes subtle eye structure and cheekbone prominence; Sub-Saharan African (10.0%) enriches skin depth and lip structure. The interplay creates a uniquely balanced phenotype—cool and warm undertones in equilibrium, neither dominantly European nor Latin nor Asian nor African, but genuinely integrated across all features.
physical_description.build: Diminutive and wiry, with the compact density of someone who has moved through the world efficiently for eight decades. No excess, no slack—shoulders slightly rounded from years of leaning in close to listen.
physical_description.hair_style: Loose, unstyled, falls naturally past her shoulders in thin strands with slight wave
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, faded slightly with age but still sharp and focused
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm golden-brown with balanced undertones—neither cool nor warm dominant, but genuinely blended. Medium depth with slight reddish warmth from Hispanic/Latin heritage balanced against subtle cool undertones from Northern European ancestry. Darker concentration at temples and cheekbones where ancestry features converge. Age has created subtle variations in tone across the face.
physical_description.complexion: Deeply lined face—forehead, cheeks, around eyes and mouth—with a map of fine creases that speak to fifty years of attentive listening and presence. Facial structure reflects Northern European definition in overall face shape, East Asian influence in subtle monolid tendency and prominent cheekbones, balanced by fuller lips and broader nasal base from African and Hispanic/Latin heritage. Eyes set with slight epicanthic fold. Skin is thin but not papery, well-cared-for despite age. Minimal makeup, if any. Expression resting in something between attention and acceptance.
distinguishing_marks: Fine surgical scar on left inner wrist from old IV placements during a 1990s hospitalization, barely visible unless she extends her hand.
Age spots on the backs of both hands, darker on the right from decades of note-taking and gesture.
A small burn scar on her left forearm from a heating unit malfunction in the 2190s—pale and smooth, no longer angry.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None visible. The cardiac monitor implant is subcutaneous—no external indicator. She wears no visible tech.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate economy. Upright despite her age, though gravity has claimed an inch or two. Her gait is slow but not hesitant—each step chosen. Her hands move with surgical precision when needed, but otherwise rest calmly in her lap or folded at her sternum. She has learned not to waste energy on movement that isn't purposeful.
physical_description.clothing_style: Always natural fiber when possible—wool, linen, cotton. Default palette is dark grey or dark green, occasionally black. Simple long-sleeve tunic or button-front shirt, loose trousers, worn but immaculately clean. No logos, no corporate branding. Worn leather slip-ons, sensible and broken in. She dresses for function and for respect to the people she sits with—nothing distracting, nothing that announces her tier or status. Tier 3-4 practical.
